scope: Read-only audit of Harbor pedestrian footbridge, two Harbor train stations, railway descriptors in x[-200,650],z[-250,400], and both ship access walkways. No production edits/removals in this turn.

findings.classification: Opaque paving over structural concrete slab; hidden top face can be consolidated, slab support/sides must remain.

findings.site: Harbor Central and Northgate upper access connections
findings.classification: Walkway overlaps platform by 7.56m2 and upper stair landing by11.07m2 at each station; prioritize trimming visible tops without weakening support.
Structural layers, not duplicated complete tracks; sum per segment, not union. Top gap45mm. Junction wedges and small structural overlaps require separate classification.
Rendered current corrected access and support; prior targeted overlap corrections retained. No new obstruction observed at sampled camera positions.

validation.footbridge: test_footbridge.gd PASS: complete ascent/crossing/descent, guardrail containment, clearance beneath,5 drawing batches. Isolated physics fixture, not global traffic approval.
validation.railway_network: 101 checks PASS: route connectivity, station identity, progression gate separation; does not certify entire physical railway.
validation.rendered: Main.tscn5sites×3frames,1280x720, daytime; images under rendered/. Not a temporal flicker or FPS benchmark.
validation.multimesh: Readback measured with real renderer; headless returned identity instance transforms and was rejected as invalid for overlap geometry.

limitations: No new runtime changes, therefore no before/after performance gain claimed.
Small beam/post contacts and stair tread overlaps are retained as raw candidates in geometry.json, not counted as pavement defects.
No approval of every train support, full train ride, night/rain or all-region rail geometry.
